data.raw_text:
PUBLIC INVITATION

Indignation protest against US bombing of Iran

June 22 Sunday 5pm
Boy Scout Rotonda, Tomas Morato, Quezon City

Bagong Alyansang Makabayan is inviting fellow Filipinos to join an indignation action to protest the US bombing of Iran

The bombing further escalates the conflict in the region and exposes the US as the biggest threat to humanity and the mastermind behind Israel’s attacks on Iran and the ongoing genocide in Palestine. 

Let us show our solidarity with the people of Iran in resisting US-Israel aggression. 

We challenge the Marcos Jr government to condemn the US bombing and to renounce the aggression of the US government. 

This also highlights the urgency for the immediate removal of all US troops, missile systems, and facilities from the Philippines as they pose a real danger to the local population. 

Condemn the US-Israel bombings on Iran! 
Resist US wars of aggression!
Stand with Iran!
